entries.install: Copy docker-compose.yml to ~/freellmapi, write ENCRYPTION_KEY and PORT=3001 to .env, docker compose up -d; open http://localhost:3001
entries.notes: Installed locally (Docker, bound to 127.0.0.1). Not a skill: one OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoint over free tiers of many providers, with failover. Provider keys are added by the user in the dashboard. Do not run setup-claude globally: it reroutes Claude Code away from Anthropic models; prefer the per-session launch command. Recommended client: OpenCode with provider freellmapi and model freellmapi/auto. Personal experimentation only; respect each provider's terms. Watchtower auto-update profile stays off (needs the Docker socket).

entries.install: claude plugin marketplace add tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction; claude plugin install fast-jev-compaction@fast-jev-compaction; set env CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1
entries.notes: Installed for Claude Code (user scope). Replaces summary compaction with verbatim Jev-scored pruning of tool calls. Needs TYPESAFE_API_KEY; sends the abridged conversation to api.typesafe.ai. Without a key it falls back to the built-in summary. Claude Code only (function hooks, 2.1.274+).

entries.install: npx skills add typesafe-ai/skills --skill typesafe-ai -a claude-code -a codex
entries.notes: Official TypeSafe skill for typed decisions with Jev. Live API calls require TYPESAFE_API_KEY and send the supplied context to TypeSafe.

entries.notes: Not installed: covered by the existing UI route and Impeccable. Use only when a project specifically needs Hallmark themes; review photo licenses and browser hook permissions.
